svg.title: Composite Order: half section · half elevation
svg.desc: Half section and half elevation of a slender fluted column whose capital combines two rows of acanthus leaves with large corner scrolls, carrying an entablature with dentils and modillions. Source: Proportions after Giacomo Barozzi da Vignola, Regola delli cinque ordini d’architettura (Rome, 1562). Simplified; drawn by Project Exodus.

g.text: SOURCE: Proportions after Giacomo Barozzi da Vignola, Regola
